source.pixelCoordinates: Offsets from the reference tile top-left; negative and >255 offsets address adjacent tiles.
limitations: These are envelopes of visibly wooded patches, not surveyed canopy edges or continuous leaf coverage.
Individual tree positions, counts, species and heights inside each envelope are unknown.
Any generated internal tree placement is an illustrative reconstruction, not individually observed trees.
Building, water, road, rail and existing-tree exclusions must be applied without moving their source geometry.
Small initial campus sample; not complete woodland coverage of the university or river corridor.
Capture period is the GSI map display, not independently verified per-patch acquisition metadata.

observationView.captureDateUncertainty: The displayed GSI period is a view label; the acquisition date for this patch is unverified.
observationView.boundaryStatus: Conservative inferred bank-side canopy core; not a surveyed boundary or individual-tree observation. Broad grass and dark river shadows were excluded.
